message.content: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: The defendant sold counterfeit shoes bearing famous brand trademarks. He knowingly sold counterfeit goods, amount huge (value 6,525,350 RMB). He was caught. The prosecution says he violated Criminal Law provisions, constitutes ... (they left blank). Also says he is a secondary participant (from-fang) and crime attempted, can be treated as attempted.

Thus the crime is "销售假冒注册商标的商品" which under Chinese Criminal Law is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (Trademark infringement) or "销售假冒注册商标的商品罪". Actually the specific article is Article 210 of Criminal Law (now 2020 amendment) "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" includes manufacturing, selling counterfeit goods. The crime is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the main is trademark infringement. The fact mentions "数额巨大" which is a factor for aggravation. So the crime is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". Also they mention "从犯" and "未遂". So only one crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>
